Backup your notes to the cloud, and use them across many devices as you\'d like while also having them end-to-end encrypted.
Login to access all your notes.
Noto is where you can jot down your thoughts, ideas, and more.\n\nYou can start by logging in, or by discovering features Noto provides.
Noto is packed with several features that make note-taking intuitive, easy to use, and straight forward, while keeping the UI minimal, modern and clutter-free.
Let\'s be honest, we all hate ads.\n\nWell, Noto doesn\'t have any! Enjoy the full experience without ads, and free of cost.
Noto is completely built on open-source software, and tools. Furthermore, You can view and inspect the code anytime on GitHub.

Manage your notes the way you want, however you want. Noto comes with a versatile amount of ways to help you better display and utilize your notes and folders to make them perfectly match you needs, including:

Performing actions on notes shouldn\'t be time consuming. With multi-selection, handling notes has never been easier with ways to batch modify almost anything for all notes in just a click of a button.

Noto ships with a comprehensive search functionality. You have the ability to search notes globally across all folders, locally inside each folder, or only inside a specific note. Finding what you\'re looking for is as easy as typing a few characters.\n\nAnd, with Continuous Search, your results are passed from one screen to another.

Notes aren\'t meant to be written only, they\'re meant for reading too. With Reading Mode, Noto takes the experience even further by providing an immersive mode, keeping the screen turned on at a customizable brightness level, and cutting all the distractions with Do Not Disturb Mode.

Making typos while writing notes isn\'t uncommon. With Undo/Redo functionality, you can revert back easily. And, even better, you can fully view all the text changes happened inside the note since the moment you opened it by using Undo/Redo History.
You can attach reminders for your notes, and you will get notified about them in time.

Noto provides a vault for your folders, which locks your notes behind a passcode or a biometric authentication if you enable it.\n\nYou can also set a timeout to close the vault after a period of time.
There are even more small features that enhance the experience, and make it joyful. And, in each new version of Noto, it unlocks even more capabilities. So, stay tuned as always!

Noto respects your privacy. Regardless of using an account or not, your data remains yours. That's why Noto can operate fully offline.

However, by creating an account, you'd be able to backup your notes to the cloud, and use them across many devices as you'd like while also having them end-to-end encrypted.

Currently, Noto uses Supabase as the open-source cloud hosting provider.
